class.name: DialogueSpeaker
class.brief_description: Who speaks a dialogue line or a subtitle: name, portrait, color and text-to-speech voice.

method.name: get_translated_name
method.description: Returns [member display_name] (or [member id] if it is empty) translated in the translation domain [code]"subtitles"[/code] with the context [code]"speaker"[/code], so the name follows the subtitles language ([method TranslationServer.set_locale_for]) like the spoken text. Without a translation, the name is returned unchanged.

method.name: load_portrait
method.description: Loads the texture of [member portrait_path] (from the resource cache if it is loaded already) and returns it, or [code]null[/code] if the path is empty or the file is not a [Texture2D].

members.member: The color of the speaker's lines and name. [SubtitleLabel] uses it for speakers without an entry in [member SubtitleLabel.speaker_colors]; white, the default, keeps the label's own text color.

The name shown to the player: a translation key or a plain name, translated by [method get_translated_name]. If empty, [member id] is shown. [method DialogueSpeakers.get_translatable_strings] adds it to POT files with the context [code]"speaker"[/code].

The key of the speaker: used by [member DialogueLineNode.speaker], [member SubtitleSegment.speaker], [member SubtitleLabel.speaker_colors] and as the persona name at [TTSServer]. Must be unique within a [DialogueSpeakers] (see [method DialogueSpeakers.validate]).

The path ([code]uid://[/code] or [code]res://[/code]) of the speaker's portrait. A path instead of a texture, so a list of speakers keeps no textures in memory and portraits can be localized by [ResourceLocalizationServer]. Load it with [method load_portrait].

The text-to-speech voice of the speaker, for lines without a recorded voice. [SubtitleServer] registers a copy at [TTSServer] under [member id], so [method TTSServer.speak_with_persona] with the speaker id uses it, and the player can change it per speaker ([TTSPersonaSettingsServer]). The persona's own [member TTSPersona.persona_name] is not used. If [code]null[/code], the speaker has no voice of its own.
